time_representation: local times with destination timezone; 2027 provisional times are not timetable confirmations
financial_rules: All shared accommodation prices are group totals, never per-person amounts unless explicitly scoped
A comparison_candidate is NOT active and is not automatically included in cost totals
Use integer cents or Decimal for money; split remaining cents deterministically by stable traveller ID
Preserve original currency and dated FX conversion rate
Pass cost and seat reservations are separate
A zero reported by Tripsy train placeholder is missing price, not free fare
import_identity: source_system + trip external_trip_id + entity external_id; use within-variant fuzzy checks only if external ID missing
alternatives: Do not combine variants or auto-select researched options. Preserve original Tripsy exactly.

source_definitions.tripsy: Private authenticated Tripsy connector read-only on 2026-11-09
source_definitions.published_tariff: Published provider reference, not 2027 live booking quote
source_definitions.historic_or_plan_total: old user-planned value, cannot be used as sale quote

privacy: Do not publish contact details, emails, booking codes or traveler identity from Tripsy in a public frontend.
